messages.subject: Project Polaris - completion arrangements (31 October)
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

We're targeting a sign-and-close on Friday 31 October. Attached is the completion checklist. Outstanding from the sellers: share certificates, board minutes, releases of the Pennine charge and the Leeds landlord consent. Buyer side is ready - board approval was given on 28 October and funds are pre-positioned. Please flag any remaining items by Wednesday close.

Kind regards,

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
